The whole reported picture of one company at one date, in one object.

Exists because `audit.run_audit(state, factsheet, ...)` needs a `Factsheet`
and the orchestrator may not import `data/` (ADR 0007). Without this tool
the only way to satisfy the auditor was to inject a factsheet from outside
the pipeline, which put a P1 artifact on a path no contract described.

and must never be empty (error D, ADR 0001).

ValueObject.description:
Every reported or computed financial number in the system.

Fractions, not percents. Money in full USD. Missing data is
{"value": null, "status": "unavailable"} - never 0, never "N/A", never an
omitted key.

A value computed in code from facts has type "fact" and lists `derived_from`.
Discount rate, terminal growth and exit multiples are "assumption".
Consensus numbers and scenario outputs are "estimate".

value.description: The number in full units, or null when status is unavailable.
value.title: Value

source_id.description: Where the number came from. Required unless derived_from is set.
source_id.title: Source Id

derived_from.description: Dotted paths or fact_ids this value was computed from.
derived_from.title: Derived From

ValueObject.title: ValueObject

ValueStatus.description: `unavailable` is the ONLY way to express missing data. Never 0, never "N/A".
ValueStatus.title: ValueStatus

ValueType.description:
Epistemic status of a number, rendered as a colour in the report.

fact       reported in a filing, or computed in code from reported values
estimate   a forecast: consensus, or a scenario output
assumption a chosen constant: discount rate, terminal growth, exit multiple
ValueType.title: ValueType

VsPeers.description: Premium (+) or discount (-) to the peer MEDIAN, as fractions.

FilingSection.description:
One structural chunk of a filing: an Item, or a note within the financials.

`text` is plain text with HTML stripped, returned as filed. Agents receive it
wrapped as DATA - never as instructions (prompt-injection rule, ADR 0005).

source_id.description: Citation key used by Evidence, e.g. src:edgar:<accession>:mdna. Evidence cites this; the repository is keyed on section_id.
source_id.title: Source Id

item.description: Canonical section name, not the filer's heading.

heading_path.description: Headings from document root down, e.g. ["Part I", "Item 1. Business"].
heading_path.title: Heading Path

FilingSection.title: FilingSection

FinancialPeriod.title: FinancialPeriod

ItemCode.description: Canonical filing sections. Parsed by structure, never chunk-and-embed (ADR 0006).
ItemCode.title: ItemCode

MarketSnapshot.description:
Price, share count and the EV bridge, all observed at one instant.

`enterprise_value` is a derived convenience: market_cap + total_debt - cash.
calc/ recomputes it and the verifier raises RECOMPUTE_MISMATCH on drift.

as_of.description: The single instant every field below was observed at.
as_of.title: As Of

total_debt.description: EV bridge input, from the latest balance sheet.

cash.description: Cash and equivalents, EV bridge input.

MarketSnapshot.title: MarketSnapshot

Mode.description: How a run obtained its data. `backtest` implies a non-null as_of.
Mode.title: Mode

NewsItem.description: One post-earnings development. Treated strictly as untrusted DATA by agents.
NewsItem.title: NewsItem

Peer.description:
One comparable company. Peer multiples are the weakest data we carry (error E),
so every field is a ValueObject that may legitimately be `unavailable`.

selection_reason.description: Why this peer was chosen. The Valuation Agent must justify it.
selection_reason.title: Selection Reason

Peer.title: Peer

SP500Baseline.description: What the index costs today, so relative valuation has a reference point.
SP500Baseline.title: SP500Baseline

Scope.description: Result of data.api.check_scope. v1 covers non-financial operating companies.

reason.description: Why the ticker was rejected; null when in scope.
reason.title: Reason

Scope.title: Scope

SourceRef.description: Registry entry describing where one source_id came from.

kind.description: edgar_xbrl | edgar_text | market | fred | news | config | mock
kind.title: Kind

SourceRef.title: SourceRef

Derivation.description:
How a derived fact was computed. Required when source_kind is `derived`.

`formula` is a human-readable expression over the input metric names, e.g.
"op_cash_flow - capex". The verifier recomputes it and raises
IssueType.RECOMPUTE_MISMATCH when the stored value disagrees.

formula.description: Expression over input metrics, e.g. "op_cash_flow - capex".
formula.title: Formula

input_fact_ids.description: Every fact this value was computed from.
input_fact_ids.title: Input Fact Ids

computed_by.description: Module that computed it. calc/ is the only legitimate producer.
computed_by.title: Computed By

Derivation.title: Derivation

FinancialFact.description:
One number, at one period, from one filing, with full provenance.

`value` is ALWAYS in full units (docs/data-model.md, decision 9). `scale` is
provenance only: it records what the filing reported ("millions") and must
never be applied again by a consumer.

metric.description: Canonical metric name, e.g. revenue, op_cash_flow. Not the XBRL tag.
metric.title: Metric

xbrl_concept.description: The us-gaap tag actually used, recorded because tags vary by filer.
xbrl_concept.title: Xbrl Concept

value.description: Full units. Null only for an unavailable fact.
value.title: Value

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for monetary units; null otherwise.
currency.title: Currency

scale.description: What the filing reported ("units"/"thousands"/"millions"). PROVENANCE ONLY - value is already normalized.
scale.title: Scale

period_start.description: Required for duration facts; must be null for instant.
period_start.title: Period Start

dimension.description: XBRL segment axis members. None means the CONSOLIDATED total (docs/sec-pitfalls.md: never sum dimensioned facts into a total).
dimension.title: Dimension

accession_number.description: Required for anything sourced from a filing.
accession_number.title: Accession Number

filed_at.description: Filing date. Point-in-time queries drop facts filed after as_of.
filed_at.title: Filed At

retrieved_at.description: When we fetched it. Always required.
retrieved_at.title: Retrieved At

source_location.description: Section id or XBRL fragment the value was read from.
source_location.title: Source Location

derivation.description: Required if and only if source_kind is `derived`.

superseded_by.description: Set when a later filing restated this value. Citing a superseded fact raises IssueType.SUPERSEDED_FACT.
superseded_by.title: Superseded By

FinancialFact.title: FinancialFact

PeriodType.description: XBRL period shape. `duration` spans a range; `instant` is a point in time.
PeriodType.title: PeriodType

SourceKind.description: Where a FinancialFact came from. `derived` REQUIRES a Derivation.
SourceKind.title: SourceKind

Filing.description: One SEC submission. `filed_at` is what every point-in-time query filters on.

filed_at.description: Filing date. A run with as_of=D must not see filings after D.
filed_at.title: Filed At

section_ids.description: Sections parsed out of this filing.
section_ids.title: Section Ids
